recommendations.name: blast-radius (blast-radius-cli)
recommendations.description: A CLI you can run in CI that lists every file depending on your changed code, directly or transitively, reports the direct and indirect dependent counts, and can fail the build past a file-count threshold; it is strongest for JS/TS and installs via npm or cargo.

recommendations.name: impact-radius
recommendations.description: A Python-installable AST call-graph analyzer that answers what breaks if you change a file and can post a Mermaid blast-radius diagram as a PR comment through a GitHub Action (I could not load its page to confirm details, so check it before adopting).

recommendations.name: Ctxo get_pr_impact
recommendations.description: An MCP tool that runs blast-radius analysis on each changed file and adds co-change history to flag files that usually change together but are missing from the PR, useful if you work with an AI coding assistant (I did not fetch this page, so details come from the search summary only).
